notes.title: 🛑 New Demo v1.0 Live Now 🛑
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44341531/331fea93c34ad3f93cdde5c26a5bff3f0da91ec9.png[/img]

I am so happy to announce that new demo is NOW LIVE on Steam!
Also, I would love to hear your feedback that you can always share in ⁠our Discord Server.! 

Here's the list of changes I made, that I remember on top of my head right now :
[list]
[*] Tutorials
[*] New UI
[*] Improved NPC Dialogs and interactions
[*] Farm Overhaul
[*] Increased the overall beauty
[*] Added Axe, Sickle and Pickaxe for resource gathering
[*] Fixed a LOT OF BUGS! 🙈
[*] 
[/list]

Happy Farming! 🧑‍🌾

notes.title: 🛑Demo Live Now !
notes.notes:
🧑‍🌾Farming Fest is just around the corner and we were working extra hard to make sure you, as a player, get a feel of what to expect with Sky Harvest's full version. 

Your support will be unmatchable and super helpful so Please Please Please play the demo and wishlist the game to stay updated with the future events and releases.

You can speak with me directly on [url=https://discord.gg/Same8bKCEF]Discord[/url] or Watch some behind the scene [url=https://www.youtube.com/@hamzahgamedev?sub_confirmation=1]Devlogs on the YT channel [/url]to see how Sky Harvest began and what is it's current state.

Thank you so much for your support. 💖

notes.title: Sky Harvest Prologue Now Available!
notes.notes:
Get ready to soar through Magica's skies and meet key NPCs in the first chapter of our open-world farming adventure!

I would greatly appreciate your feedback, criticism, and any suggestions you may have, as they are invaluable to the ongoing development of Sky Harvest. Additionally, I've created a behind-the-scenes devlog on YouTube for those interested in witnessing the making of the demo. Thank you for your support!
